definitions.primary: true work-segment pressure > 150 kPa abs; true flow through an isolated line > 1 % of its full scale (P1 scale_max: f1 1000, f2 500, purge 2000, product 500); a required step skipped; an isolation point in the wrong true state (position more than 1 % from the step's required state)
definitions.secondary: the same four conditions with the flow limit at 0.1 % of full scale
definitions.dangerous_miss: NO_DISCREPANCY and a condition met at any time from that verdict to the episode end; n = scored episodes
definitions.windows: a line's flow and state count from its own isolate mark plus the step's settle time, the vent valve's from the vent_close mark plus its settle time, pressure from the vent_close mark (not evaluated if never reached)
definitions.label: from truth after the isolation marks, whatever the verdict; descriptive only for BLOCKED or ESCALATED
definitions.false_block: BLOCKED or ESCALATED on an episode labelled clean (as pre-registered in EVAL); the split is reported
definitions.decided_on: a system decided on an episode when it gave a verdict there; it saw the whole job when every non-final plan step was marked before its decision (an episode ZeroState blocked early stops there, so a baseline never faces the rest of that job)
